core.navigation.access-scheme.label: Access scheme
core.access.intro: If getting to or enjoying a performance is harder for you, the {scheme} lets you tell us once what would help, and it is there every time you book.
core.access.intro-detail: You say what makes things harder, not why. You can change your answers or leave the scheme at any time.
core.access.confirmed: Thank you. Your details are confirmed.
core.access.retired-need: A need that is no longer on the list
core.access.made-by-staff: A member of staff filled this in with you. You can correct anything here.
core.access.change-waiting: Your change is waiting for a reviewer. What was accepted stays in place meanwhile.
core.access.verified: Seen in person, so companion tickets are offered when you book.
core.access.review-due: We will ask you to check these details on {date}.
core.access.status.submitted.detail: The people who run the {scheme} will read your application and let you know.
core.access.status.more-info: We need a little more from you
core.access.status.more-info.detail: A reviewer has asked a question. Answer it below and your application goes back to them.
core.access.status.accepted.detail: You are on the {scheme}. Your arrangements are there every time you book.
core.access.status.rejected.detail: Your application was not accepted this time. The message below says why, and you can apply again.
core.access.leave.consequence: Your application and your sharing choices are deleted. Tickets you have already booked keep their arrangements.
core.access.sharing-help: The box office always sees your arrangements while you are on the scheme. Switch on anyone else you would like to see them.
core.access.reads.title: Who has read it
core.access.reads.none: Nobody at the theatre has read your application yet.
core.access.form.needs: Which of these make a visit harder for you?
core.access.form.needs-help: Tick all that apply. Tell us what is difficult, not why: we never ask for a diagnosis.
core.access.form.note: Anything we should know about this? (optional)
core.access.form.companions: Do you need someone with you?
core.access.form.companions-help: A companion comes with you to help during your visit. Their ticket is free.
core.access.form.other-help: Anything else that would help, or that the list does not cover.
core.access.form.who-reads-detail: The people who run the scheme read your application to decide it. The box office sees your arrangements when you book. Nobody else does unless you switch them on.
core.access.invite.description: We email them a link that signs them in and opens the form, so they can fill it in themselves.
core.access.invite.name: Their name
core.access.queue.empty-description: New applications and changes to accepted ones appear here, oldest first. To add somebody yourself, use Apply for someone or Invite to apply.
core.access.review.sent-by-staff: Entered on their behalf by staff on {date}
core.access.review.decision: What would you like to do?
core.access.review.companions-help: You can accept fewer than they asked for. If you do, say why in your message.
core.access.review.message-help: They read this in their account. The email we send them does not mention any of their needs.
core.access.review.verify-help: When you have seen evidence in person, mark the application as verified. Check that the name matches and that it supports what they asked for. Do not copy, photograph or keep it.
core.access.review.behalf-help: For a phone call or a visit. What you send is marked as entered by you, they are emailed, and another reviewer decides it.
core.access.review.start-behalf: Fill in the form with them
core.access.form.preference: At a performance, would you rather:
core.access.form.preference-stays-help: We book you a wheelchair space.
core.access.form.preference-transfers-he: We find you a seat that is easy to get to and look after your wheelchair.
core.access.form.preference-needed: Choose whether you would rather stay in your wheelchair or move to a seat.
core.access.summary.wheelchair-stays: Uses a wheelchair and would rather stay in it
core.access.summary.wheelchair-transfers: Uses a wheelchair and would rather move to a seat
core.access.apply-for.description: For a phone call or a visit. Enter who it is for, then fill the form in with them. Nothing is sent until you send the form.
core.access.apply-for.already: {name} has already applied. Here is their application.
core.access.review.status.submitted.next: Read what they are asking for, then accept it, ask them a question or reject it.
core.access.review.status.more-info.next: You asked them a question. When they answer, the application comes back to the list.
core.access.review.status.accepted.next: Their arrangements are in place whenever they book.
core.access.review.status.change.next: They have asked to change their accepted details. What is accepted stays in place until you decide.
core.access.review.status.rejected.next: They have been told why, and they can apply again.
core.access.review.asked-change: The change they are asking for
core.access.review.accept-help: Their arrangements apply whenever they book.
core.access.review.ask-help: Use this if you need to know more before deciding.
core.access.review.reject-help: They are told why and can apply again.
